description: This file appears to be a shell script used for device initialization and LED status management within an embedded Linux system, specifically for OpenWrt/LEDE projects. It manages LED triggers based on different system states such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, and done.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the trigger attribute of the status LED to its default based on device tree configuration.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED behavior based on the system state such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, or done.
